notes.title: Attendance reasons
notes.subtitle: Reasons employees gave for their days. Approve, excuse, or reject with its pay effect; ask for more information when it is unclear.
notes.oversightBanner: You are reviewing as HR (organisation-wide oversight), not as the employees' line manager. Your decision overrides the manager's step and is recorded as an override.
notes.emptyHint: Reasons employees add to their days appear here while they wait for a decision.

hints.approve: The reason is accepted; the day stays as the engine calculated it.
hints.excuse: The day is excused: no deduction applies and it is counted as excused.
hints.reject: The day is treated as unexcused. Choose its pay effect.
hints.request_info: The employee is notified, answers by editing the reason, and it comes back to you.

review.payEffectHint: Charged to a paid leave balance first, then as loss of pay (organisation rules).
review.question: Question for the employee
review.questionPlaceholder: What would you like to know?
review.oversightNote: You decide as HR oversight, not as the line manager.

charge.lop: {{days}} day recorded as loss of pay
charge.covered_by_leave: The day is covered by leave; nothing charged
charge.excused: The day is excused; nothing charged

selfies.rejectHint: No punch is recorded. The employee sees your reason.
selfies.emptyHint: Selfie check-ins of employees with open attendance appear here for review.

grants.title: Portal attendance
grants.hint: How this employee may punch from the employee portal. Saved at once and recorded in the audit log.
grants.openAttendanceHint: May check in from anywhere with a selfie that a manager reviews before it counts.
grants.selfieRequiredHint: Every portal punch of this employee must be a selfie check-in.
grants.selfieOff: Selfie check-in is turned off for the organisation (Settings → Attendance), so no selfie is asked for: this employee punches as usual until it is turned on.

geofences.title: Geofences
geofences.subtitle: Work zones portal punches are checked against. Assign each zone to the organisation, a branch, department, team or employee; the most specific scope wins.
geofences.dialogHint: A circle around the site (and, optionally, a polygon for its exact outline).
geofences.deleteHint: Its assignments go with it. Punches already recorded keep the verdict they had.
geofences.emptyHint: Create a zone around each site employees punch from in the portal.

fields.name: Name
fields.polygonHint: One point per line: latitude, longitude (3–100 points). Leave empty for the circle.
fields.windowsHint: When the zone applies, in the site's local time. Leave empty to apply at all times.

enforcementHint.hard_block: A punch from outside is refused (the organisation rule may soften this to a flag).
enforcementHint.soft_warn: A punch from outside is recorded with the OUTSIDE_GEOFENCE flag for review.
enforcementHint.advisory_log: A punch from outside is recorded; the location is only logged.

errors.name: Give the zone a name.
errors.radius: A whole number of metres between 30 and 5000.
errors.accuracy: A whole number of metres between 5 and 5000.
errors.grace: A whole number of metres between 0 and 1000.
errors.dates: The end date must be on or after the start date.
errors.windows: Every window needs at least one day, a start and an end.

assignments.title: Who {{name}} applies to
assignments.hint: The most specific scope with a fence wins (employee, then team, department, branch, organisation); within it the strictest verdict counts.
assignments.none: Not assigned to anyone yet — the zone applies to nobody.
assignments.invalid: Choose a target for every line; each line applies to check-ins, check-outs or both.

tester.title: Test a location
tester.hint: Dry run: how would a punch by this employee at this location be judged right now? Nothing is recorded.

modes.block: refuse where the zone says so

tester.noFences: No fence applies to this employee.

geofences.precedence: Which zone judges a punch: the most specific assignment that applies to the employee wins (employee, then team, department, branch, organisation). Within that scope the worst result decides — one zone the punch is outside of is enough to flag or refuse it.
geofences.readOnlyBranch: Read-only: it belongs to another branch or to the whole organisation.
geofences.readOnlyReach_one: Read-only: it also applies to {{count}} target outside your branches.
geofences.readOnlyReach_other: Read-only: it also applies to {{count}} targets outside your branches.
